events.content:
I want a small app for keeping track of the books I'm reading.

When I open it I want to see what I'm currently reading and what I've finished. I want to add a book from a form, mark one as finished, and click through to a book to see its title, author and my notes. I'd like to be able to send someone a link to a single book.

Nothing fancy and no accounts. Skip the database, save the books to a JSON file so they're still there after a restart.
I’ll inspect the starter app, then build the book list, add form, detail links, and JSON-file storage using its existing stack.

events.content:
Built the book tracker. The home page separates currently reading and finished books; you can add a book with notes, mark it finished, and open or share its individual page. Books are saved to data/books.json and remain available after a restart. No database or accounts are needed.

Run it with npm start, then open http://localhost:3000.

Verification passed (exit code 0): npm test covered adding, direct links, finishing, and persistence after restart; npm run build and node --check app.js passed.
